title: CLI and Notebook share session_id
summary: qteasy-ai CLI and %%qtai use the same session_id protocol.
narrative:
CLI: `qteasy-ai plan "..." --session-id my-session`. Notebook: `%%qtai --mode plan --session-id my-session`. The same id revises the last closed ToolPlan instead of starting a new one-shot classify.

Without --session-id, each utterance is a single sentence (today's D/E behaviour). Ask can reuse the id for a short slot summary and still calls zero skills.
python_code:
from qteasy_ai.app import QteasyAssistant
assistant = QteasyAssistant()
assistant.plan('帮我下载日线', session_id='demo', response_style='raw')
print(assistant.plan('20240101 到 20241231', session_id='demo', response_style='raw')['plan']['planner_trace']['source'])
risk_notes: Do not put secrets in session_id. Sessions live under QTEASY_AI_HOME/sessions/.
